name: fastapi
description: Production FastAPI lifespan templates, Granian ASGI launchers, pgvector HNSW search handlers, and Pydantic v2 configuration recipes

lifespan_handler.description: FastAPI Lifespan handler initializing asyncpg with pgvector binary codecs, Valkey, and NATS
lifespan_handler.code:
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.pg_pool = await asyncpg.create_pool(dsn=settings.DATABASE_URL.get_secret_value(), init=register_vector)
    yield
    await app.state.pg_pool.close()
